followUpTo: ISSUES #172 (#140 family): a LOCKED + ENCORED battler must not take the Encore retarget draw (audit aud159, STEP enc160)
title: A STATUS2_MULTIPLETURNS (Ice Ball) battler Encored mid-turn stays on the locked arm: no GetMoveTarget draw while the roll continues (census 0..999 battle 771 shape)
scenario: Player SEALEO L10 (ICE BALL / HAIL / SPLASH x2) vs faster PLUSLE (ENCORE x4). Turn 1 ICE BALL starts the roll; turn 2 PLUSLE's Encore lands (encoredMove ICE BALL) and SEALEO keeps rolling. Turn 3+ SEALEO is locked AND Encored: the locked arm runs ICE BALL with no GetMoveTarget. Later free turns select slot 1 HAIL (probe --slot-plan 0,1) and the Encore / lock interplay recurs over 20 turns.

sourceUnderTest.lockedArm: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_util.c:107-110 HandleAction_UseMove: gBattleMons[attacker].status2 & (STATUS2_MULTIPLETURNS | STATUS2_RECHARGE) -> gCurrentMove = gChosenMove = gLockedMoves[attacker], NO GetMoveTarget call (the target banked at the locking turn rides). Checked BEFORE the Encore arms
sourceUnderTest.encoreArm: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_util.c:111-117 (encoredMove == moves[encoredMovePos] -> GetMoveTarget) and :119-128 (overwritten -> clear Encore, GetMoveTarget) -- only reached when the locked arm does not match
sourceUnderTest.setEncore: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_script_commands.c:8017 Cmd_trysetencore: no STATUS2_MULTIPLETURNS / RECHARGE check, so a locked battler can be Encored; encoreTimer = (Random() & 3) + 3 at :8039
sourceUnderTest.getMoveTarget: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_util.c:3828 GetMoveTarget; MOVE_TARGET_SELECTED do { Random() % gBattlersCount } while (target == attacker ...) :3850-3853

portSitesAtHead.turnStart: src/engine/factoryBattleScriptFullTurnDecision.ts actionRetargetsAtExecution (pre-fix): returned encoreTimer != 0 && encoredMove != 0 with no lock guard (its comment claimed 'a locked battler carries no Encore'); playerRetargets / trainerRetargets feed runMoveAction's retargetsAtExecution, which calls drawActionMoveTarget
portSitesAtHead.actionTime: actionEncoreArm / actionTakesChosenMoveChangedArm already return early on battlerStatusMoveLock(...) != 0

fixShape: ISSUES #172 / STEP enc160: actionRetargetsAtExecution returns false when battlerStatusMoveLock(preClearRulesContext, battler) != 0 (source order: the :107-110 locked arm precedes the :111-128 Encore arms). If a faster foe clears the lock mid-turn, runMoveAction's action-time actionEncoreArm still takes the Encore arm and draws.
